- a definitive SKU mapping (which of our product SKUs map to Redwood hosted SKUs / metering buckets)
- evidence items for co-sell certification (SaaS description, screenshot pack, security artifacts)
- an outline of billing & metering expectations so our finance team can pre-approve the offer terms

Thanks for the ping. I've reviewed the CSV and sketched a working checklist; uploading the evidence checklist and a starter SKU map for your team. High-level observations:

- SKU granularity: two Stratus SKUs (SB-Analytics, SB-Streaming) map to a single Redwood hosted SKU for metered inference. We should confirm if Stratus wants separate billing lines or a combined view.
- Security artifacts: we need a short SOC2 statement, TLS certs summary, and a screenshots pack with login flows (SSO + service console).
- Demo credentials: we prefer ephemeral demo keys and a short walkthrough script for reviewers.

Attached: syndication-evidence-checklist.pdf, sku-mapping-2029-08.csv (annotated).

If Stratus can provide the SOC pointer and the screenshot pack by Sep 4, I can assemble the binder and run a pre-cert check on Sep 5. Otherwise we'll need to push the publish window by one week.

--
Olga Petrov
Director, Partner Catalog & Syndication | Redwood Inference

Quick notes from billing/metering POV:

- Metering buckets: Redwood uses inference-unit buckets by model class + sequence-length band. We should map SB-Analytics -> inference-standard; SB-Streaming -> inference-stream. See attached usage-sample-2029-07.txt for expected token distribution.
- Price floor: If Stratus wants separate charge lines, marketplace listings usually accept bundled pricing but the metering report will need a mapping sheet (we can publish both separate and combined SKUs but only one canonical metering column).
- Trial/credits: recommend a 14-day trial with a soft cap and redirect billing to Stratus post-trial. That reduces friction for co-sell approvals.

I'll prepare a canonical SKU->metering mapping template by EOD Mon (9/2) and share a small script to transform your CSV into the required marketplace format.

-Karthik
Senior Manager, Commercial Integrations | Redwood Inference
